Arma 3 [[Arma 3: Main Updates|main branch update]] change logs are presented as {{Link|https://dev.arma3.com/spotrep|SPOTREPs on the official Dev Hub}}. 

The change logs on this Wiki are for its more experimental / testing [[Arma 3: Steam Branches|Steam branches]].
{{Feature|informative|Change logs like these have historically been posted to the {{Link|https://forums.bohemia.net/|Bohemia Interactive forums}}, but those have been offline or in read-only mode since 2025.
